subject.title: Set cacheRead & cacheWrite to default to zero instead of not reporting

question: Should OpenClaw maintainers port/request a clean upstream fix for missing cache price defaults, or wait for the existing fork PR to be resubmitted narrowly?
rationale: The bug shape is clear, but there is an open external fork PR with the same idea and unrelated changes, and current labels already pause new automated fix PR creation.

options.title: Port a narrow upstream fix
options.body: Apply the shared pricing-boundary default with focused tests in openclaw/openclaw and let the fork PR close as superseded once an upstream PR lands.

options.title: Ask for a clean upstream PR
options.body: Invite the contributor to resubmit only the estimator change and regression tests against current main.

options.title: Wait on the fork PR
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the external fork branch, accepting that no upstream fix is currently mergeable from this repository.

recommendation.title: Port a narrow upstream fix
recommendation.body: Apply the shared pricing-boundary default with focused tests in openclaw/openclaw and let the fork PR close as superseded once an upstream PR lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The usage cost reporting and diagnostics exporter path traces back to steipete-authored commits, making this the strongest available routing signal.
